messages:
luis: Heads-up — starting rollout of quant-kernel v2.1 into the night window (00:00 UTC). This includes a matmul microkernel change + small ABI tweak. Kicking canary at 10% first.

deploy-bot: deploy started: job=engine-quant-v2.1 window=night bucket=canary rate=10%

amelia: drafting release-notes now — will call out ABI bump, fallback variant, and pin instructions.

raj: what's the rollback play if we see perf regressions? pin to v1.9 and force fallback model variant?

mara: rollback steps in ops-runbook: 1) pin nodes to image `engine:2026-03-15-abi1.9` 2) re-route canary traffic back 3) validate p99 for 10m before unpin.

kim: quick question — KV cache format unchanged with this build? don't want cache invalidation mid-rollout.

luis: KV cache format is compatible. main risk is FP diff in quant matmul causing occasional CPU fallback and tail latency blips. watching error-rate and P99 closely.

deploy-bot: canary report: hosts_healthy=18/20, p99_latency_change=+2.1%, token_error_rate=+0.1%

amelia: looks okay so far. I'll push the release-notes draft to docs and ping eng-runtime.

raj: plan: staged ramp to 50% over 30m if no regressions. luis to own the ramp?

luis: I'll run the ramp. abort criteria: any host healthcheck fail or p99 +>5% sustained for 5m -> pin and rollback. deploy-bot will auto-splitback on failing hosts.

ops-bot: alert: GPU OOM traces detected on 3/4 test runs in region us-west-2 (task=engine-quant-v2.1).

mara: seeing the same. starting manual rollback of the 3 hosts to v1.9 and draining them for reimage. collecting logs.

deploy-bot: canary aborted: reason=OOM spikes in us-west-2, action=hold at 10% traffic. To abort full rollout, run `/deploy abort engine-quant-v2.1`

luis: holding the rollout. Mara — collect OOM logs and share. Amelia — mark release-notes as paused.

amelia: updated notes: "rolling canary paused due to OOM in us-west-2; investigating. Contacts: luis, mara". pushed to docs.

raj: add a Dedicated customer note: they can pin to `engine-quant:v1.9` via API — include cURL example in notes.

mara: uploaded logs to s3://redwood-ops/oom-dumps/1729004444.tar.gz

luis: thanks. reconvene in 15. if no quick mitigation, we'll rollback the entire night window and open a patch branch for matmul microkernel.

kim: I'll run a microbench of the matmul hotpath with a scaled-down workload to reproduce OOM.

deploy-bot: next actions to resume: `deploy resume engine-quant-v2.1 --force` OR to rollback+pin: `deploy rollback engine-quant-v2.1 --pin engine-quant:v1.9`

mara: adding follow-up action and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-kernel.yml :thumbsup:

luis: thanks all — updating the incident doc, leaving this thread open for follow-up and root-cause.
